notes: Reproduces what the three director training topics conferred before roles existed.
Before roles, holding a director training did three things: it put you on the application
notification list, and — for Executive Director only — it unmasked applicant contact details
and allowed the final approve/reject/park decision. Everything else a director did came from
is_admin, which is untouched by this file.
The privileges below are the pre-roles behaviour plus the review-desk access a director needs
to exercise it without being an administrator. Note that view_pii is Executive Director only:
that matches the old masking rule, and is the one place this file is deliberately narrower
Import in replace mode. If you already ran the seed migration, detach 'Application approver'
and 'Application reviewer' from the three director topics afterwards, or those bundles will

roles.name: Executive Director
roles.description: Owns the application queue and makes the final approve, reject, or park decision. The only office that sees applicant contact details unmasked.

roles.name: Associate Executive Director
roles.description: Works the application queue and votes, without the final decision. Applicant contact details stay masked, as they did before roles.

roles.name: Assistant Executive Director
roles.description: Works the application queue and votes, without the final decision. Applicant contact details stay masked, as they did before roles.
